posts.title: Disney on Ice: ‘Jump In!’
posts.headline: 周末亲子精选
highlights: 迪士尼众多角色滑上冰面：乐佩与弗林空中旋转，莫阿娜与毛伊跨越大海，还有米老鼠和伙伴现场挥手致意。可加购 Magic Pass，享独家角色见面与优选座位。
posts.description: My daughter’s favorite movies are (big surprise) all Disney, and she is a fan of nearly every character. Many of them will be skating across the rink this weekend during these special performances. Watch Rapunzel and Flynn Rider spin through the air, cheer on Maui and Moana as they cross the ocean, and wave to Mickey and friends! Add on a Magic Pass for an exclusive character greeting and premium seats.
posts.caption:

Friday–Sunday, Oct. 23–25 · 11 a.m.–12:30 p.m. · Accesso ShoWare Center

Watch Rapunzel and Flynn Rider spin through the air, cheer on Maui and Moana as they cross the ocean, and wave to Mickey and friends! Add on a Magic Pass for an exclusive character greeting and premium seats.

posts.title: Pythagorean Palooza
posts.headline: 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 赶上本世纪难得一遇的“毕达哥拉斯三元组”日，一起用有趣方式复习勾股定理。逛三角主题展、挑战益智谜题，在亲子互动中探索数学之美。
posts.description: If helping your kids with their homework has started to feel a little challenging, this is the spot to make learning about math more fun! First, you’ll need to brush up on the Pythagorean theorem, because Saturday’s date is a Pythagorean triple. That won’t happen again this century, and the Seattle Universal Math Museum is making the most of it. Explore triangle-themed exhibits, solve puzzles and learn more about mathematics.
posts.caption:
这个周末去Kent玩什么？🌿

推荐：Pythagorean Palooza
免费入场，Saturday, Oct. 24 · 1–7 p.m. · SUMM at Kent Station

If helping your kids with their homework has started to feel a little challenging, this is the spot to make learning about math more fun! First, you’ll need to brush up on the Pythagorean theorem, because Saturday’s date is a Pythagorean triple. That won’t happen again this century, and the Seattle Universal Math Museum is making the most of it. Explore triangle-themed exhibits, solve puzzles and learn more about mathematics.

posts.description: It’s not too late to spot salmon ! Walk along the Sammamish River Trail, learn about the salmon life cycle and spot a few triumphant fish. The trail is flat and accessible, and a scavenger hunt (with prizes!) adds to the fun.

roundup.title: 本周末亲子活动精选｜6城8场
roundup.caption:
这个周末，6 个城市都有适合家庭的活动！🌿

本周亮点包括「Kitsap Live Steamers Ghost Train」和「Issaquah Zombie Walk」，适合安排轻松又充实的亲子时光。从户外探索到社区活动，各个城市都有值得带孩子一起体验的选择。

我们整理了 8 场地区亮点：

- Port Orchard：Kitsap Live Steamers Ghost Train
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 24
  地点：South Kitsap Regional Park · 3100 S.E. Marbeth Ln., Port Orchard
  亮点：搭乘 Kitsap Live Steamers 迷你“幽灵列车”，穿行森林来一场惊悚之旅。

- Issaquah：Issaquah Zombie Walk
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 24
  地点：Historic Shell Station and Downtown Issaquah · 232 Front St. N., Issaquah
  亮点：🎟️ 活动免费参加。

- Seattle：The Museum of Fright
  日期：Sunday, Oct. 25
  地点：The Museum of Flight · 9404 East Marginal Way S., Seattle
  亮点：博物馆化身惊魂乐园，8-Bit Brass Band 现场演奏助兴。

- Seattle：Fall Lantern Festival
  日期：Friday, Oct. 23
  地点：Freeway Park · 700 Seneca St., Seattle
  亮点：彩灯点亮公园，现场有艺术手作、趣味游戏和现场音乐。

- Kent：Disney on Ice: ‘Jump In!’
  重复活动：Friday–Sunday, Oct. 23–25；本次采用：Friday, Oct 23
  系列页面：https://www.parentmap.com/series/disney-on-ice-jump-in/
  活动详情：https://www.parentmap.com/calendar/disney-on-ice-jump-in/2026-10-24/1/
  地点：Accesso ShoWare Center · 625 W. James St., Kent
  亮点：迪士尼众多角色滑上冰面：乐佩与弗林空中旋转，莫阿娜与毛伊跨越大海，还有米老鼠和伙伴现场挥手致意。

- Kent：Pythagorean Palooza
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 24
  地点：SUMM at Kent Station · 437 Ramsay Way, Suite 102, Kent
  亮点：赶上本世纪难得一遇的“毕达哥拉斯三元组”日，一起用有趣方式复习勾股定理。

- Redmond：Salmon Discovery Walk and Scavenger Hunt
  重复活动：Saturday–Sunday, Oct. 24–25；本次采用：Saturday, Oct 24
  系列页面：https://www.parentmap.com/series/salmon-discovery-walk-and-scavenger-hunt/
  活动详情：https://www.parentmap.com/calendar/salmon-discovery-walk-and-scavenger-hunt-2/2026-10-24/
  地点：Sammamish River Trail · 15670 N.E. 85th St., Redmond
  亮点：沿着步道观赏回游的鲑鱼，边走边了解鲑鱼的生命历程。

- Tacoma：Shorts4Shorties at The Tacoma Film Festival
  日期：Sunday, Oct. 25
  地点：The Grand Cinema · 606 Fawcett Ave., Tacoma
  亮点：亲子友好短片专场，适合大小朋友一起观影。

收藏这份周末清单，带上家人一起出门玩吧！

想让周末更轻松？来 SproutCue 找附近的 playdate、游乐场、故事时间和周末活动吧！🛝📚 创建你的家庭卡片，认识附近愿意一起玩的家庭，一起发现更多亲子时光！💛
